_comments: The WS-2 reconcile sweep, on MJ's own scheduler (ActionScheduledJobDriver runs the
'Reconcile Entitlement Provisioning' action; the JobTypeID lookup resolves against the
job types MJ core seeds). SHIPS DISABLED: a deployment flips Status to Active after one
clean manual run of the action - silent first-run surprises are how sweeps earn distrust.
Hourly at :07, seconds-leading six-field cron, deliberately off the :00 herd.

fields.Name: Orders: Reconcile Entitlement Provisioning
fields.Description: Re-drives entitlement grants whose downstream provisioning is outstanding (Pending, retryable Failed, RevokePending) with exponential backoff and a bounded attempt ceiling. See the 'Reconcile Entitlement Provisioning' action and docs/HOW_THE_SYSTEM_WORKS.md.
